description: Automotive, ideal-diode reverse-polarity-protection controller for an external N-channel MOSFET.

pinout.name: EN
pinout.notes: Enable pin. Can be connected to SOURCE for always-ON operation.

pinout.name: VCAP
pinout.notes: Charge pump output. Connect to external charge pump capacitor (to SOURCE).

pinout.name: SOURCE
pinout.notes: Input supply pin to the controller. Connect to the source of the external N-channel MOSFET.

pinout.name: GATE
pinout.notes: Gate drive output. Connect to gate of the external N-channel MOSFET.

decoupling.value: 0.1uF (recommended operating condition, VCAP to SOURCE external capacitance)
decoupling.placement: kept away from the MOSFET to lower thermal effects on the capacitance value
decoupling.notes: Charge pump capacitor; sized per recommended operating conditions table.

decoupling.value: >22nF (recommended operating condition, SOURCE external capacitance); higher than 22nF ceramic bypass recommended if input supply is more than a few inches from the device
decoupling.notes: Power Supply Recommendations section: device operates 3.2V <= VSOURCE <= 65V; use a supply with overload/short-circuit protection.

land_pattern.notes: IPC land pattern from TI's example board layout: 8x pads 0.45mm x 1.05mm at 0.65mm pitch, non-solder-mask-defined preferred. No exposed pad on this package.

layout_notes: Connect SOURCE and GATE pins of the LM74500-Q1 close to the MOSFET's SOURCE and GATE pins.
The high-current path runs through the external MOSFET; use thick traces for the MOSFET source and drain to minimize resistive losses.
Keep the charge-pump capacitor (across VCAP and SOURCE) away from the MOSFET to limit thermal effects on its capacitance value.
Connect GATE to the MOSFET gate with a short trace; avoid excessively thin or long gate-drive traces.
If the input supply is more than a few inches from the device, add an input ceramic bypass capacitor larger than 22nF at SOURCE.
